notes.title: Update v1.1.2 out now!
notes.content:
v1.1.2

Fixes:

- Fixes issue where new horses disappear after breeding
- Fixed barn flickering
- Fixed breeding issue where new foals replaced adults
- Fixed blinding sparkling on horses
- Fixed burnt out screens in many instances (please report if you still experience this)
- Fixed issue where pasting a horse name from clipboard can contain invalid characters 

New Features and Enhancements:

- Main game now features the more detailed versions of the Horses (as featured in The Race DLC)
- Sped up countdown at the end of trainings
- Timer under clock now shows remaining time for Quests
- Racing against a developer will now show an Artery Studios logo above Developer’s horses for distinction

More features to follow shortly in the next weeks with more fixes, enhancements and features!

Report any issues you find here. 
Thank you.

notes.title: Update 1.10 out NOW!
notes.content:
Hello!

The update that has been in the beta branch for the last few days has officially gone live! Apologies for the delay, however some large bugs appeared (Which have been dealt with now!) which delayed this release. Patch notes below!

[quote=ArtertyStudios]
Version 1.10, 4th August 2014
[b]+++ The Race (DLC) expansion changes:[/b]

- Leaderboards Support! (Arriving Tuesday, August 12th!) 
- Particles tweaked for better visibility and performance
- Hang on pressing “Leave” during race fixed
- Minimize under Windows doesn’t quit race anymore
- Camera during race now doesn’t go through meshes (collision fixed)
- Numerous performance optimisations
- Small tweaks on maps
- "Magic Crystals" achievement requirements lowered from 50 to 3

[b]+++ Main game changes:[/b]

- Menu button moved to top right and changed to icon from text
- Sound and music play fixed
- Player running out of terrain in training fixed
- Other small tweaks and fixes
[/quote]


Have a great day and we hope you enjoy Secret of the Magic Crystal! ːcloverː

notes.title: New Update out Monday!
notes.content:
Hello!

The developers over at [b]Artery Studios[/b] are pleased to announce a new update, rolling onto your Steam Client this Monday! This update brings some minor fixes, and an all new Leaderboard system for the official DLC "[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/305570/]The Race![/url]". The full changelog is below:


[quote=ArteryStudios]+++ The Race (DLC) expansion changes:

- Leaderboards !!! 
- Particles tweaked for better visibility and performance
- Hang on pressing “Leave” during race fixed
- Minimize under Windows doesn’t quit race anymore
- Camera during race now doesn’t go through meshes (collision fixed)
- Numerous performance optimisations
- Small tweaks on maps

+++ Main game changes:

- Menu button moved to top right and changed to icon from text
- Sound and music play fixed
- Player running out of terrain in training fixed
- Other small tweaks and fixes[/quote]

In other news, there is something very exciting in the works right now. Not all the details are set just yet, but keep an eye on the official forums here on Steam for more information at a later date.

Thanks for reading guys, and have a great day! ːcloverː

notes.title: v1.0.8 is now LIVE!
notes.content:
1.0.8 brings the following : 

+ fixes colour burning in training scene 
+ game now runs in background (many of you asked for this) 
+ Enhanced lighting and visual improvements throughout the game 
+ Many optimisation and more quality levels to suit any System 
+ Loading tips to help you learn the game quicker 
+ Enhanced intro sequence with new music 
+ Enhanced training gameplay with new music 
+ Quest now shows how long it will take and how much money you will get 
+ auto highlight shows what can you interact with 
+ Linux now also has a proper resolution dialogue window 

+ Many other bug fixes and tweaks to enhance overall look&feel and gameplay

more to come in 2014...
